messages:
julie: Quick check: who else treats semver like a suggestion box? v3.2.1 -> v3.2.1-please-work :laughing:
owen: it's more of a ritual. we chant the changelog and hope. :pray:
pat: YAML dad joke: 'I tried to be YAML, but my indentation let me down.' :sweat_smile:
julie: saw a convo earlier where someone published v0.0.0-alpha-alpha. the dependency tree sobbed. :weary:
owen: found this gem in a config today:
```yaml
service:
  name: metrics
  enabled: yes
  tags: [prom, "true"]
```
owen: parser: 'nope' :ghost:
linter-bot: Lint results for branch feature/semver-freedom: 12 warnings, 0 errors. Suggestion: rename version to v3.2.1-hotfix. :robot_face:
pat: compiler meme: 'Undefined behavior walks into a bar. The bar collapses and we file a postmortem.' :rofl:
julie: mini poll: PR title 'fix' -> do you open it or assume it's whitespace? yes/no/only-if-tests-fail
owen: only_if_tests_fail
pat: vote to add :semver-shrink: emoji.
linter-bot: Fun fact: 37% of config bugs at 3am are caused by stray tabs.
julie: goodnight everyone, may your YAML be valid and your semver consistent. :crescent_moon:
